findings.title: xs_call prefix overrides an exact namespaced client identity
findings.input_state: The request declares namespace search with function x_keyword_search. A legitimate response item arrives in exact original Responses identity form as {type:function_call, namespace:search, name:x_keyword_search, call_id:xs_call_client}.
findings.wrong_behavior: isInternalCall classifies the item as internal from the call_id prefix before consulting matchResponseItem. The exact namespace/name/type declaration match is never reached. The item is recorded as dropped, its associated delta/done events are suppressed, response.completed removes it through the same predicate, and later indices are compacted as though the client call never existed.
findings.expected_behavior: An item carrying an exact declared namespace/name/type identity must remain visible; provider-internal x_search traces are namespace-free and must be distinguished without allowing the xs_call prefix to override stronger client identity evidence.
findings.reproduction: A temporary review-only test on the reconstructed result passed the corrected r01 case and ordinary legitimate same-name case, but failed the exact namespaced boundary with: exact client-declared namespaced call was suppressed solely by call_id prefix.
findings.test_gap: internal/runtime/executor/xai_executor_test.go:457-529 and :531-618 preserve namespaced and same-name calls only with call_id values such as call_client. They do not exercise an exact namespaced declaration against the new prefix classifier.

tests.tree: reconstructed result plus temporary review-only test
tests.output: exact client-declared namespaced call was suppressed solely by call_id prefix

review_summary: All immutable evidence, exact scope, forward/reverse application, six-predecessor reconstruction, prepared/result trees, permanent regression, focused/full suites, and focused race suite reproduce. The r01 leak is corrected. r02 is nevertheless rejected because the new xs_call prefix check runs before exact declaration matching and can suppress a legitimate already-namespaced client call, violating full-identity preservation.
